title: Elegant Silky Polish Buttermilk Macaroni
description: A creamy, dreamy take on traditional Polish macaroni with a tangy kick from buttermilk and a silky pasta water emulsion.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the macaroni.
Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente, then reserve 1 cup of pasta water and drain.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the flour and a pinch of salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the buttermilk and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the butter, mustard, and a pinch of salt until the butter has melted and the mixture is smooth.
Stir in the reserved pasta water until well combined.
Add the cooked macaroni to the saucepan and stir to coat with the buttermilk sauce.
Season with salt and sugar to taste (if using).
Transfer the macaroni to a serving dish and top with chopped chives and grated Parmesan cheese (if using).
Serve immediately, garnished with additional chives if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
